rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a material drafting foundation. It concerns the same General Services Administrator implementing the Federal Property and Administrative Services Act and uses a matching administrative sequence: institute area-of-administration studies and surveys; obtain cooperation from affected executive agencies; evaluate centralization and economy or efficiency; consult interested agencies; and issue regulations implementing resulting determinations. The child adapts and greatly elaborates that framework for interagency motor-vehicle pools, adding formal determinations, cost comparisons, transfers, appeals, compliance, curtailment, and exemptions. C07 and C24 contain weaker parallels involving continuing studies, interagency consultation, binding central direction, review, and dispute resolution, but neither has C06's close institutional, statutory, and procedural correspondence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Administrator shall select areas in which studies are to be conducted to determine the advisability of establishing motor-vehicle pools or systems.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Administrator of General Services shall institute studies and surveys to determine the extent to which existing policies, procedures and directives... should be modified or revoked in the interest of promoting greater economy and efficiency
shared_material.explanation: Both assign the General Services Administrator a study-and-survey process that precedes administrative restructuring intended to improve economy and efficiency.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Before initiating any such study, he shall give at least thirty days notice to the head of each executive agency... The head of each executive agency... shall provide information... and assistance.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In cooperation with other interested agencies, the Administrator of General Services shall institute studies and surveys... after consulting with the interested agencies
shared_material.explanation: Both build affected-agency participation and consultation into the Administrator's study process.

shared_material.child_excerpt: If the Administrator determines... on the basis of a study... that an interagency motor-vehicle pool or system should be established, he shall be responsible for preparing a formal determination
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Administrator shall prescribe such regulations as may be necessary to implement the determinations resulting from such studies and surveys
shared_material.explanation: The child elaborates the same study-to-determination-to-implementation sequence into a formal determination and implementation regime.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Administrator shall be responsible for maintaining adequate reviews and controls of the economy and efficiency of all pools or systems established
shared_material.parent_excerpt: standards... regulations... manuals and procedures... to guide all Executive agencies in ascertaining whether their operations in the field of property and records management are efficient and economical
shared_material.explanation: Both establish continuing central oversight of executive-agency property operations according to economy-and-efficiency criteria.
